choice.basis: The task requires selecting the highest-risk state from the dashboard for priority follow-up. The dashboard’s legend explicitly maps color to risk index: pale yellow (High, 100) to dark maroon (Low, 0). Visual inspection of the map shows Illinois (IL) is pale yellow, Kansas (KS) is dark maroon, and Delaware (DE) is orange. Under the legend, pale yellow indicates the highest risk, dark maroon the lowest, and orange an intermediate level. Therefore, Illinois is the highest-risk state among the three options.
choice.option_label: Open Illinois (IL) risk detail for priority follow-up
